implementation: openagents labs anime catalogue, direct WORDS --take FILE, and play FILE OUT.png|OUT.mp4
behavior: Catalogue comes from the checked Anime vocabulary. Direct uses payload-bound NIP-98, validates the complete public reply, preserves answer metadata, and atomically appends one bounded written line under a cooperating-writer lock.

Play uses the existing headless muted shot/clip engine, requires the page to acknowledge the accepted take before capture, and protects take/output aliases. Relative ffmpeg paths are literal; requested frame directories must be new or empty and are regenerated even when the video was cached.
native_scope: The built CLI signs with a fresh in-memory identity against the actual local director API and a synthetic selector. Independent negative HTTP fixtures cover client refusals. PNG pixels and all twelve clip frames match equivalent shot/clip captures; ffprobe verifies silent H264 output. The changed producer separately qualifies colon filenames, requested frame regeneration and video-only cache reuse.
